simple.meaning: חָצוֹת (châtsôwth) is a Hebrew word meaning “the middle (of the night).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חָצוֹת (H2676) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 11:4, with occurrences in Exodus, Job, Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָצוֹת (H2676) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חָצוֹת (H2676) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חָצוֹת (châtsôwth) / H2676 is traced through Exodus 11:4, Job 34:20, Psalms 119:62 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
